title: SEOSONA Flow ↔ Video AI V2 — data contract
description: One source of truth for the data exchanged between SEOSONA Flow (visual generation, this MCP server) and SEOSONA Video AI V2 (voice/edit/render). Flow produces SILENT visual assets; V2 owns the script + voiceover and muxes Flow assets into the final video. This keeps content↔voice aligned. Optional link: if the MCP server is present, V2 pulls assets through it; otherwise both products run independently.

Download.description: Result of export_asset — where the extension saved the full asset on the user's disk (Chrome cannot expose an absolute path, so V2 reads it under the Downloads folder).

folder.description: Subfolder under the user's Downloads directory.

path_hint.description: e.g. "Downloads/seosonaflow_mcp/asset_123.mp4" — resolve against the OS Downloads dir.

FlowAsset.description: A single generated visual asset returned by gen_image / gen_video / run_workflow.

asset_id.description: Stable id for referencing this asset from a scene (Flow file_name / tile_id when available).

url.description: Full-resolution asset URL (video_url for videos). May require the user's Google session to fetch.

file_name.description: Flow file name — reuse as a ref in later gens.

FlowResult.description: Envelope returned by every MCP tool call (see server.mjs normalizeResult).

batch.description: Per-prompt success/fail detail for multi-prompt calls.

data.description: Present for discovery / project / memory tools (domain fields).

idempotent_hit.description: true when this envelope was returned from the client_ref cache without regenerating (see gen_* client_ref).

error_code.description: e.g. PROVIDER_NOT_LOGGED_IN, WRONG_PROJECT, DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, EXTENSION_BUSY, VALIDATION_ERROR.

SceneInput.description: How a V2 script.json scene requests a visual from Flow. V2 resolves this to an MCP tool call, then fills scene.asset with the returned FlowAsset.

script.description: V2's render script.json — V2 OWNS this. Flow never generates or reads voiceText; it only fulfills scene.inputs via SceneInput. Mirrors the video-ai-v2-pipeline skill.

voice.description: V2-owned voice (NOT Flow). Provider is V2's TTS (sidecar), not Veo.

voiceText.description: V2 TTS reads this — the master clock. Flow is blind to it.

asset.description: Filled by V2 after resolving inputs through the MCP server.

Quality.description: Verdict from Flow-side judging (QualityGate + QualityJudge). Present only when the call asked for quality_gate. ALWAYS check judged before trusting pass: judged=false means nobody looked at the pixels, so pass is null and the asset needs a human. Flow never regenerates on a fail — it reports action and lets the caller decide, so a retry is always the caller spending their own quota knowingly.

judged.description: true = a judge actually ran. false = judging was unavailable (no vision tab, model returned no JSON, timeout).

pass.description: Passed the threshold. null when judged=false.

score.description: Weighted 0-10 across the applicable dimensions. Motion and temporal dimensions are omitted for images. null when judged=false.

verdict.description: critical_fail = a CRITICAL defect was found; it fails regardless of the average score, because averaging hides a six-fingered hand behind good composition.

action.description: What the caller should do next. review_manually is what an unjudged asset gets.

critical.description: Human-readable critical defects, empty when none.
